questions.question: How can you ensure that your application is highly available in AWS?
feedbacks: By deploying your application across multiple Availability Zones, you ensure redundancy and high availability in case one zone fails.

Load balancing helps distribute traffic but does not guarantee high availability by itself.

questions.explanation: High availability is achieved by distributing application components across multiple Availability Zones to prevent single points of failure.

questions.question: Which AWS service helps automate the deployment of applications across multiple instances?

questions.question: What is the purpose of AWS CloudTrail?
